title: Local DVR cohomology normal form and its consecutive-quotient Tor obstruction
statement: Let T be a noetherian scheme of bounded Krull dimension, l invertible in all its stalks, and E/Q_l a finite extension. For any bounded constructible intrinsically complete complex K for the actual unlifted Padic datum [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and any degree q, there are a finite stratification and pro-etale covers such that the restricted H^q(K) is F plus N, with F a finite free module sheaf and N admitting a nilpotent endomorphism f. For some quotient index n, cokernel(f) is an epimorphic image of the coefficient-restricted pullback of Tor_1 of H^q(K_(n+1)) for the quotient map R_(n+1) to R_n [prop-weil-pbc-levelwise-truncations]. No Tor vanishing assumption is made.

source.place: DVR model decomposition and torsion-block calculation, proof steps 5--7; separated from flatness descent.

external.place: Tag 0ASV; explicit periodic quotient resolution in the parent proof

proof.text: Choose a finite stratification and pro-etale covers with constant perfect valuation-ring models, using the integral stratified-perfect characterization. Its published Lean interface uses a lifted coefficient datum and smaller field universe: transport along a small algebraically isomorphic finite extension and the valuation-ring/quotient-ring isomorphisms, then transport the models back to the actual unlifted datum. Restriction is exact, preserves completed coefficients on locally closed strata and slice objects, and commutes with derived quotient extension. The completed constant realization is exact on finite modules and compatible with the whole quotient diagram.

Over the integer DVR every finite projective term is finite free. At the highest degree, Smith normal form gives an image basis with nonzero diagonal entries. Lift that basis to the preceding term. Its span splits off from the differential kernel, which contains the incoming differential. Split off the resulting two-term blocks and unused free vectors, then recurse downward. Normalize every nonzero diagonal entry to a uniformizer power. Discard unit blocks. In degree q, realize the one-term free blocks as F and the positive-power cokernels as N. Finite sums give the sectionwise rank-r basis and the cohomology isomorphism. Multiplication by the uniformizer on N is nilpotent, bounded by the largest block exponent.

Choose n at least the largest torsion exponent. With quotient index n denoting exponent n+1, the consecutive quotient has the alternating free resolution with differentials uniformizer^(n+1) and uniformizer. Tensoring a degree-q torsion block makes the former differential zero, giving its Tor_1 equal to its quotient by the uniformizer. The block decomposition makes the direct sum of these quotients a direct summand of the Tor_1 of reduced degree-q cohomology. Projection is the required epimorphism t onto cokernel f after scalar restriction. Constant sheafification is exact; bounded-above flat resolutions compute derived tensor. The restriction comparisons identify this Tor with the displayed ambient Tor pullback. If no torsion is present take N=0 and the map to zero; empty charts are included.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_adic_cohomology_torsion_normal_form
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (hl : ∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) (q : ℤ) :
    let d := pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E
    let B := pbcAdicCompletion T d
    let tor (n : ℕ) := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-1)).obj
      ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n))).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            ((pbcCompletedReduction T d (n + 1)).obj K.obj))))
    ∃ (S : Stratification T)
      (V : ∀ a : Fin S.n, Cover.{u + 1} proetalePrecoverage (S.domain a)),
      ∀ (a : Fin S.n) (j : (V a).I₀),
        let g := (V a).f j ≫ S.immersion a
        let B' := (adicTowerInverseImage g).obj B
        let P := proEtaleRingModulePullback g B B' (Iso.refl _)
        ∃ (r : ℕ) (F N : pbcModules ((V a).X j) B'),
          (∀ U : ((V a).X j).ProEtᵒᵖ,
            Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin r) (B'.obj.obj U) (F.val.obj U))) ∧
          Nonempty (P.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K.obj) ≅ F ⊞ N) ∧
          ∃ f : End N, IsNilpotent f ∧ ∃ n : ℕ,
            ∃ t : (pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
                (pbcAdicProjection T d n))).obj
              ((proEtaleRingModulePullback g ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n))
                ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n)))
                (Iso.refl _)).obj (tor n)) ⟶ cokernel f,
              Epi t
